author: reek
body: Adversarial probe (effect rows stage 0). Fire-and-forget laundering: a def declared pure forks an effectful thunk and never awaits it. fork's parameter is a pure arrow (TypeEnv), so the thunk's Console effect is invisible to the spawner's signature. Effect rows stage 3b charges the spawner (fork : (Nothing -[e]-> a) -[e]-> Task a) and rejects this (CDX2090: the thunk's Console row cannot reconcile where the enclosing context requires purity). This test is the enforcement's regression guard.
